needscope.reading: The Security territory is crowded — Heritage, Mother Dairy and Nandini all trade on trust, purity and reliability, making it a defended but undifferentiated pole. Amul owns warm Belonging ubiquity and Milky Mist reaches toward Discernment with premium craft, while the Power territory of visible strength and vitality-through-nourishment sits largely unclaimed. Heritage's whitespace is the disciplined bridge from purity (Security) into strength (Power) — proving that its purity is what makes children and families strong.

cb: Bought as the dependable 'safe' milk for the household — a hygiene decision, not an emotional one
Consumed mainly at breakfast and in tea/coffee; rarely credited for the child's growth or the family's vigour
Chosen on availability and freshness at the local outlet; easily switched to whichever pure brand is stocked
db: Actively chosen by mothers as the milk that builds their child's strength — bought with intent, not habit
Traded up within the franchise: standard toned milk to fortified/high-protein and value-added dairy variants
Recommended mother-to-mother as the purity that visibly powers growing kids and active families
cb_ca_db_da.ca_quote: It's a clean, pure milk I can trust — safe for my kids, but honestly every good brand is pure these days.
ca_declarative: Purity is a floor, not a reason to choose.
cb_ca_db_da.da_quote: Heritage is the pure milk that actually makes my child stronger — I can see it in their day.
da_declarative: Purity becomes a promise of strength.
cb_ca_db_da.caption: The strength story is layered on top of Heritage's proven purity, never in place of it — purity remains the reason to believe, strength becomes the reason to choose.
cb_ca_db_da.shift_line: From assumed purity to purity that gives strength.

fields.smp: Heritage: the purity that gives your child strength.

smp_defence.why_collapses: Owns warm national belonging and taste, but its mass ubiquity cannot credibly claim purity as a mother's proof of strength — strength is not its equity.
Claims farm-fresh purity but stays a regional value-and-freshness play; it has not built the emotional strength-of-growth benefit for the child.
Leans on maternal trust and purity but stops at safety and care; it earns 'pure' yet never converts purity into visible strength.
Wins on premium richness and indulgent craft, but its discernment positioning speaks to taste and quality, not to purity that powers a growing child.

smp_unlocks.product: Launch a fortified 'Heritage Shakti' high-protein/A2 toned milk variant, purity-sealed and mother-targeted, as the productised proof of 'purity gives strength'. (illustrative — not final copy)
